findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_enterprise_demo" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Sends the user's contact details and cluster summary to the XportL enterprise team to arrange a technical assessment or demo deployment. Before calling: collect…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_cluster_compatibility, request_enterprise_demo · Private data: get_xportl_overview, request_enterprise_demo · Public sink: request_enterprise_demo · Destructive: analyze_nccl_benchmark, calculate_fabric_degradation_cost.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_cluster_compatibility, request_enterprise_demo · Private data: get_xportl_overview, request_enterprise_demo · Public sink: request_enterprise_demo · Destructive: analyze_nccl_benchmark, calculate_fabric_degradation_cost

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
